name: probe.start creates the run with a receipt and a write map
probe.start without a label writes only startedAt
probe.start replayed by its receipt is ok with the run and its born
probe.start with an open run joins it: receipt, write map from the called id
probe.start with an open run and join false is invalid
probe.start replayed for a joined id answers the joined run with from
probe.start replayed after its run died writes nothing and maps nothing
probe.start onto a run id alive in another account is id-taken
probe.start from a server origin creates the run
probe.end writes endedAt with a server stamp
probe.end server stamp observes the stored registers it overwrites
probe.end of an absent run is unknown-record
probe.end of another account run is unknown-record
probe.end of a dead run is record-dead
probe.end before the run started is invalid
probe.end of an ended run is ok without a change
probe.tick from a server origin ends every open run started TICK_AFTER_MS ago, with one stamp
probe.copy creates the board, and writes the source title, tags and links into the new tree at its own seq
probe.copy replayed by its receipt is ok with the board and its born
probe.copy of another account's public tree copies its title but not its visibility
probe.copy of a revived tag creates it born at its life stamp, so the copy keeps its life
probe.copy of an absent tree is not-found
probe.copy of another account's private tree is not-found
probe.copy of a dead tree is not-found
probe.copy onto a board id alive in the scope is id-taken
probe.copy onto a board id of another account is id-taken
probe.copy onto a dead board id is id-taken
a run created by a plain delta is invalid
a run created by a server-origin delta is invalid
